messages.text:
"Create a complete mobile 3D puzzle adventure game called THE LAST FOLD.

CORE CONCEPT:
The entire game world is made of paper. The player controls a small character who must reach the exit of each level by physically folding the world using touchscreen gestures.

MAIN GAME MECHANICS:

- Swipe across the screen to create a fold line.
- Drag one side of the paper world over the other.
- Objects, platforms, enemies and characters move together with the folded paper.
- Overlapping surfaces can create bridges, shortcuts and new paths.
- Some objects can only be reached by flipping or folding the world.
- Incorrect folds can create obstacles or trap the player.

GAMEPLAY:

- Third-person isometric 3D camera.
- Smooth touchscreen controls.
- 100 progressively challenging levels.
- Each level introduces a new puzzle mechanic.
- Multiple possible solutions for certain levels.
- Collectible hidden golden origami stars.
- Unlockable character skins and environments.

WORLDS:

1. Paper Forest
2. Frozen Origami
3. The Forgotten City
4. Floating Islands
5. The Cosmic Paper World

VISUAL STYLE:
Beautiful stylized 3D graphics, realistic paper textures, dynamic shadows, satisfying folding animations, atmospheric lighting and polished environments.

USER INTERFACE:
Minimalist mobile interface with Play, Level Selection, Settings and Skins.

IMPORTANT:
Make the folding mechanic the central feature of the game. The player must physically manipulate the geometry of the level, not simply activate predefined bridges or teleport objects.

Create a fully playable prototype with a main menu, tutorial, at least 10 playable levels, restart functionality, level progression, sound effects and mobile-friendly controls.

Prioritize smooth performance on Android devices. Don't try to build all 100 levels right away. First, create 3 fully functional levels and focus on perfecting the folding mechanic. Make sure the controls feel intuitive, the animations are smooth, and the puzzles are genuinely fun. If the core mechanic is enjoyable, you'll have a strong foundation for a successful game. (App)

---
This is a build request. Build a complete, playable game now (or apply the requested change to the existing game). Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly when you finish.

Screenshots for your own checks: save small JPEGs (a .jpg path, viewport at most 1280px wide) and read only the latest one; older images are dropped from context. Read a full-size PNG only when fine detail matters.
"
